automated_tests.name: Extras Categorical Encoding & Run Reconstruction
automated_tests.evidence: Match 14113 (RR Won by 3 Runs): Reconstructed Innings 1=165, Innings 2=162 (Diff=+3r exact match; Naive sum gave Innings 1=879). Verified extras1_runs=6 on all 189,167 legal rows.

automated_tests.name: Scorecard Reconciliation Across 396 Non-DLS Run-Margin Matches
automated_tests.evidence: Reconstructed MAE = 2.47 runs vs Naive MAE = 39.04 runs (126/396 exact 0-run matches, 362/396 within <=5r).

automated_tests.name: Legal Deliveries & Balls Faced Accounting
automated_tests.evidence: 7,714 wides excluded from both legal balls & balls faced; 840 no-balls excluded from bowler legal balls but counted in batter balls faced; 192,444 legal balls verified.

automated_tests.name: Bowler-Credited Wicket Filtering
automated_tests.evidence: 10,272 bowler-credited wickets retained (Bowled, Caught, LBW, Stumped, Hit Wicket); 600 RunOuts, 6 Retire Out, and 3 Obstructing the Field excluded.

automated_tests.name: Situational Pressure Index Calibration (1st vs 2nd Innings)
automated_tests.evidence: Over 1 (0 wkts down) Mean P = 0.137 vs Over 19–20 Chase (RRR 12–16, 5+ wkts down) Mean P = 0.729.

automated_tests.name: Strict Pre-Delivery Zero-Leakage Invariance
automated_tests.evidence: Mutating delivery t=50 and all future deliveries t>50 in Match 13512 produced max |Delta P_t| = 0.00e+00 across all deliveries t <= 50.

automated_tests.name: Empirical Bayes Shrinkage Monotonicity
automated_tests.evidence: Exploratory samples (<60b) pulled 80.9% toward role prior vs Strong samples (300+b) pulled only 26.3%.

automated_tests.name: Official Top 10 Export & Leaderboard Parity
automated_tests.evidence: Exported official_batter_rankings.csv and official_bowler_rankings.csv match calculated PRS leaderboards 10/10.

automated_tests.name: Duplicate Player ID Prevention & Cross-Country Homonym Separation
automated_tests.evidence: 0 duplicate player_ids or names in official rankings; 4 multi-ID duplicates merged; 3 cross-country homonyms disambiguated.
